answer_2.quote: We use (1) attack success rate -the ratio of the successful attacks to total number of attacks, (2) query count -the number of queries, (3) perturbation rate -the percentage of words substituted in an input and (4) grammatical correctness -the average grammatical error increase rate (calculated using Language-Tool) to verify the quality of generated adversarial examples.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted human evaluation to assess the quality of generated adversarial examples. ... We asked the evaluators to classify the adversarial examples and score them in terms of grammatical correctness (score out of 5) as well as its semantic similarity compared to the original text.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to classify each adversarial example, rate grammatical correctness on a 1‑5 scale, and assign a semantic similarity score (0, 0.5, or 1).
